import openpyxl
import os

output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/402-43_0_84ff81ea/1_402-43_output.xlsx'
if not os.path.exists(output_path):
    print("File not found")
    exit()

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path)
ws = wb['Sheet2']

for r in range(1, 11):
    for c in range(1, 34):
        val = ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value
        print(f"Cell {ws.cell(row=r, column=c).coordinate}: {val} (Type: {type(val)})")
